name: @agent/schemas
//: An internal workspace package. The 'exports' map points straight at
TypeScript source instead of a compiled dist/ directory. Turborepo
calls this a 'just-in-time package': nothing builds, the consumer
transpiles. It works because every consumer here is an application we
run ourselves. A package published to npm must ship compiled JS +
.d.ts instead, built with tsup or tsdown.
